title: Correct NEXY L1o Lo3 Lo2 roles from authoritative design document
inputs_summary: User reported prior L1o explanation did not match the design file; authoritative DOCX was read directly.

sources.document: แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา.docx

actions: Read the attached DOCX directly because indexed file search returned no results.
Compared early detailed Trinity definitions with the later L600 reframing and Final Absolute Architecture.
Corrected the conceptual model without mutating the source specification or implementation.
corrected_claims: L1o is not merely a reasoning layer and not the whole-system controller; the source names it The Sovereign Core and later finalizes it as the Deterministic Logic Core.

L1o's core purpose is bounded/provable deterministic logic under strict constraints, centered on dependency-graph reasoning, constraint processing, multi-path generation/pruning, recursive audit and verified-state flow.
Lo3 is The Swarm Governor: it controls external AI workers, decomposes tasks, shards context, orchestrates agents, attacks weak outputs and drives proof-based consensus.

Lo2 is The Singularity Hub/Core: it consumes verified success schemas/results, extracts logic quanta, cross-verifies them and synthesizes/evolves laws; it does not consume raw user input in the L600 design.
The Final Absolute Architecture separates L1o/Lo3 from Decision Synthesis, Risk & Safety Evaluation, Execution Control and the immutable Safety Kernel.
next_actions: Use this source-bound role model in future NEXY discussions and audits; do not collapse L1o into generic 'reasoning layer' or call it the sole controller.
